verdict.rationale: LangGraph is pip-installable OSS with a local CLI/Agent Server and production-grade Postgres checkpointers, indicating genuine self-hosting capability, but the evidence pack repeatedly ties 'production-ready deployment' and tracing/debugging to LangSmith/Agent Server infrastructure, and a community source explicitly asks how to run it as a production API 'beyond running langgraph serve locally,' signaling real friction in fully vendor-independent production deployment. missing for 10: clear documentation of a fully self-hosted production deployment path (scaling, HA) without any LangSmith/Platform dependency, and independent confirmation that self-hosted deployments match vendor-hosted feature parity.
